The Women's trap event at the 2020 Summer Olympics took place on 28 and 29 July 2021 at the Asaka Shooting Range.[1]

Records

Prior to this competition, the existing world and Olympic records were as follows.[2]

Qualification records
World record  Satu Mäkelä-Nummela (FIN)123 Acapulco, Mexico18 March 2019
Olympic record Not established– ––
Final records
World record  Ashley Carroll (USA)48 Guadalajara, Mexico5 March 2018
Olympic record Not established– ––
